# opusdns_zones (Data Source)

Fetches the list of all DNS zones in your OpusDNS account.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opusdns_zones" "all" {}

output "zone_names" {
  value = [for z in data.opusdns_zones.all.zones : z.name]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A static identifier for this data source.
- `zones` (Attributes List) The list of DNS zones. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--zones))

<a id="nestedatt--zones"></a>
### Nested Schema for `zones`

Read-Only:

- `dnssec_status` (String) The DNSSEC status of the zone.
- `name` (String) The domain name of the zone.
